deals.name: Everyday milk scan-back
deals.terms: $0.08 per gallon scanned at POS in all pilot stores. Billed monthly from store scan data; payment due net 30.

deals.name: 2026 annual volume rebate
deals.terms: Retroactive tiered rebate on annual purchases at net cost: 1.0% up to $1.8M, 1.5% from $1.8M, 2.0% from $2.6M. Accrued at the projected tier; trued up quarterly.

deals.name: Whole Milk 2 for $6 funding
deals.terms: $0.35 per unit scanned during the promotion. Covers ~70% of the price reduction.

deals.name: Greek yogurt 32 oz new-item slotting
deals.terms: One-off $9,000 ($300 per pilot store) to add the item to the dairy planogram. Deducted from the first payable after the item ships.

deals.name: Back to School Bread BOGO funding
deals.terms: $0.90 per unit sold on BOGO, from POS scan data. Deducted from the DSD invoice payments.

deals.name: Q3 bakery off-invoice allowance
deals.terms: 3% off the invoice cost on every DSD delivery. Applied at receipt, so net cost flows straight to margin.

deals.name: Weekly circular — bakery feature
deals.terms: $1,200 per circular week × 12 feature weeks. Earned when the circular runs; proof of performance attached.

deals.name: Labor Day Water $2.98 funding
deals.terms: $0.60 per unit scanned during the Labor Day price cut.

deals.name: Summer hydration scan-back
deals.terms: $0.20 per unit scanned, June to September. Billed monthly.

deals.name: 2026 water volume rebate
deals.terms: Retroactive tiered rebate on annual purchases: 0.75% to $900k, 1.25% from $900k, 1.75% from $1.4M.

deals.name: Q4 stock-up off-invoice
deals.terms: 5% off invoice on orders shipped 5 Oct – 27 Dec. Watch forward-buying: see open-to-buy for Household in December.

deals.name: Paper goods display bill-back
deals.terms: $0.50 per unit sold while the item is on a secondary display (endcap or pallet drop). Performance checked from planogram photo audits.

deals.name: Endcap program Q3
deals.terms: $18,000 for one endcap per pilot store for 13 weeks.

deals.name: Fiesta avocado bill-back
deals.terms: $0.05 per avocado sold. Billed monthly from POS movement.

deals.name: 2026 produce volume rebate
deals.terms: Retroactive tiered rebate: 0.5% to $1.2M, 1.0% from $1.2M, 1.5% from $2.0M. Deducted quarterly.

deals.name: Halloween Cola member price funding
deals.terms: $1.10 per unit scanned at the $4.99 member price. Linked to promotion PRM-2702; accrues from POS once it goes live.

deals.name: Thanksgiving Juice 2 for $6 funding
deals.terms: $0.45 per unit scanned during Thanksgiving week.

deals.name: 2026 beverage volume rebate
deals.terms: Retroactive tiered rebate: 1.0% to $1.5M, 1.75% from $1.5M, 2.5% from $2.3M.

deals.name: Sports drink new flavours slotting
deals.terms: $7,500 slotting for two new flavours in the sports-drink bay.

deals.name: Member app feature — holiday drinks
deals.terms: $12,000 for a hero tile in the member app and two push notifications.
